title: Manager - Purchase (Retail Pharmacy Background MUST)
description:
Job Title: Manager Purchase (Retail Pharmacy) 
 Department: Supply Chain / Procurement 
 Reporting To: Head Procurement / Supply Chain Head 
 Job Purpose The Manager Purchase will be responsible for planning, sourcing, negotiating, and procuring pharmaceutical products, RX products, wellness products, medical devices, and healthcare consumables for the retail pharmacy business. The role will focus on ensuring product availability, optimizing procurement costs, maintaining supplier relationships, and supporting business growth through effective inventory and purchasing strategies. 
 Key Responsibilities 
 Procurement & Vendor Management Manage end-to-end procurement of pharmaceutical products, RX Products, OTC medicines, healthcare products, nutraceuticals, medical devices, and consumables. Develop and maintain strong relationships with pharmaceutical manufacturers, distributors, stockists, and suppliers. Negotiate pricing, commercial terms, trade schemes, credit periods, and annual contracts to maximize profitability. Identify and onboard new vendors to expand product assortment and improve commercial terms. Conduct periodic vendor performance reviews and ensure service-level compliance. 
 Inventory Planning & Availability Collaborate with Supply Chain, Category, and Operations teams to ensure optimum inventory levels across stores and warehouses. Monitor stock availability and proactively manage replenishment to prevent stock-outs and excess inventory. Drive inventory optimization initiatives, including reduction of slow-moving and non-moving stock. Analyze demand patterns and seasonal trends to support procurement planning. 
 Commercial & Cost Optimization Achieve procurement savings through strategic sourcing and vendor negotiations. Manage trade margins, rebates, promotional schemes, and commercial agreements. Evaluate procurement opportunities to improve gross margins and working capital efficiency. Monitor market pricing and competitor activities to ensure commercial competitiveness. 
 Data Analysis & Reporting Analyze procurement trends, purchase performance, stock coverage, expiry risks, and supplier performance metrics. Prepare MIS reports, dashboards, and procurement performance reviews for management. Leverage data analytics to support decision-making and purchasing strategies. 
 Compliance & Quality Assurance Ensure procurement practices comply with applicable pharmaceutical regulations and company policies. Coordinate with Quality Assurance teams to ensure procurement from authorized and compliant suppliers. Monitor product documentation, licenses, certifications, and statutory requirements. 
 Cross-Functional Collaboration Work closely with Category Management, Supply Chain, Warehouse, Finance, Operations, and Store Teams. Support new product launches, promotional campaigns, and business expansion initiatives. Participate in demand forecasting and assortment planning exercises. 
 Qualifications Bachelor's Degree in Pharmacy (B.Pharm), Life Sciences, Commerce, or related discipline. MBA / PGDM in Supply Chain, Operations, Procurement, or Marketing preferred. 
 Experience 610 years of experience in Procurement, Purchase, Category Buying, or Supply Chain within Retail Pharmacy, Healthcare Retail, Pharmaceutical Distribution, or FMCG sectors. Strong experience in pharmaceutical product procurement and vendor negotiations. Experience handling large procurement budgets and supplier networks. 
 Required Skills & Competencies Strong understanding of pharmaceutical supply chain and retail pharmacy operations. Excellent negotiation and commercial acumen. Vendor management and relationship-building skills. Inventory planning and demand forecasting knowledge. Strong analytical and problem-solving capabilities. Proficiency in ERP systems, procurement platforms, and MS Excel. Effective communication and stakeholder management skills. 
 Key Performance Indicators (KPIs) Product availability and service levels. Procurement savings and margin improvement. Inventory turnover and stock cover. Reduction in stock-outs and excess inventory. Vendor performance and compliance scores. Working capital optimization. Expiry and dead stock reduction. 
 Preferred Industry Background Candidates should have experience in: Retail Pharmacy Chains Pharmaceutical Distribution Healthcare Retail Pharmacy Procurement & Category Management 
 Experience with leading pharmacy retail organizations, pharmaceutical distributors, or healthcare retail businesses will be highly preferred.

title: Procurement Specialist / Associate Manager - Centre Procurement
description:
Procurement Specialist / Associate Manager - Centre Procurement Location: Gurgaon
 Function: Procurement - Healthcare Operations
 Reporting To: Senior Manager - Procurement Role Overview The Procurement Specialist / Associate Manager will manage centre-level procurement requirements across the company s healthcare and diagnostic centres. The role will handle procurement requests from initiation to delivery, including requirement validation, vendor sourcing, quotation analysis, commercial negotiation, purchase coordination and delivery tracking. The person must be diligent, analytical, commercially strong and capable of managing multiple requirements through ERP systems, Excel and collaboration tools while maintaining high ethical standards. Key Responsibilities Procurement and Purchase Management Manage procurement requests received from multiple centres. Review specifications, quantities, urgency, approvals and operational requirements. Procure medical consumables, laboratory supplies, equipment, facility materials and operational services. Process purchase requests and purchase orders in accordance with approved policies. Track requests, approvals, orders and deliveries until closure. Prioritise critical requirements to prevent disruption to centre operations. Consolidate requirements across centres wherever commercially beneficial. Vendor Management and Commercial Negotiations Identify, evaluate and onboard suitable vendors and service providers. Obtain competitive quotations and prepare commercial comparisons. Negotiate pricing, payment terms, delivery timelines, warranties and service conditions. Monitor vendor performance, quality, pricing and delivery commitments. Maintain a reliable and diversified vendor network. Resolve vendor-related issues and recommend corrective action where required. Centre Coordination and Supply Planning Work closely with centre managers, operations, quality, finance and other central teams. Provide regular updates on procurement status, delays and supply risks. Monitor consumption and availability of critical supplies. Support demand planning, forecasting and timely replenishment. Identify repeated emergency purchases, excess stock and slow-moving items. Challenge incomplete, unclear or commercially unreasonable requests where necessary. Process Control, Compliance and Reporting Ensure compliance with procurement policies, approval limits and documentation requirements. Maintain complete records of quotations, comparisons, approvals, purchase orders, contracts and deliveries. Maintain procurement trackers and reports using ERP systems, Excel and collaboration tools. Report open requests, delivery status, savings, procurement timelines and vendor performance. Support procurement audits, SOP development and process improvements. Maintain transparency, confidentiality and high ethical standards in all vendor dealings. Mandatory Requirements Bachelor s degree in Business Administration, Supply Chain Management, Procurement or a related field. 6-10 years of relevant procurement experience. Prior experience with a diagnostic chain, laboratory network, hospital chain or similar multi-location healthcare business. Experience managing procurement requirements for multiple centres or branches. Strong commercial negotiation, quotation analysis and vendor management skills. Good working knowledge of ERP systems, Microsoft Excel and collaboration or task-management tools. Strong analytical, documentation, follow-up and task-tracking abilities. Ability to manage multiple priorities with accuracy and attention to detail. High standards of integrity, confidentiality and ethical conduct. Preferred Requirements Experience working in a startup, growing business or rapidly expanding organisation. Experience procuring medical consumables, laboratory supplies, equipment and facility-related services. Exposure to procurement dashboards, cost-saving initiatives and vendor performance reviews. Experience improving procurement processes, SOPs and technology-based tracking systems. Familiarity with quality, compliance and audit requirements in healthcare operations. Prior experience of working with international vendors

description:
Job Summary We are seeking a high-performing Manager / Senior Manager to lead and manage large-scale CSR initiatives . The role requires a seasoned project management professional who can take complete ownership of program planning, execution, stakeholder engagement, governance, reporting, and impact delivery. The ideal candidate will have extensive experience managing CSR, education, skilling, or workforce development programs and possess a deep understanding of the ecosystem involving government agencies, academia, industry bodies, training partners, and implementation organizations. We are not looking for experience of vocational skilling. This individual will serve as the central point of coordination across all stakeholders and ensure seamless end-to-end project delivery, achievement of program outcomes, and long-term sustainability of initiatives. Key Responsibilities Program & Project Management Lead end-to-end execution of CSR projects from inception to closure. Develop detailed proposals, project plans, timelines, governance mechanisms, risk registers, and delivery frameworks. Drive program implementation across multiple institutions, geographies, and stakeholders. Relationship in Government Universities, Ministries and agencies for student/learner mobilisation. Access and connect with delivery Partners in different domains such as Cyber, AI, Analytics, Emerging trends, Etc. Monitor project milestones, budgets, deliverables, and outcomes to ensure timely and high-quality execution. Identify risks, dependencies, and bottlenecks and proactively drive mitigation plans. Ensure compliance with CSR objectives, contractual obligations, and reporting requirements. Stakeholder Management Win relevant CSR projects for the firm. Build and manage relationships with key stakeholders across: Government departments and agencies Universities and higher education institutions Industry associations and sector councils CSR foundations and nonprofit organizations Training and implementation partners Internal leadership and business teams Act as the primary interface between sponsors, implementation partners, and beneficiary institutions. Facilitate steering committee meetings, governance reviews, and executive stakeholder discussions. Ecosystem Development & Partnerships Leverage existing networks to create strategic partnerships within the skilling, and education ecosystem. Identify opportunities for collaboration with government bodies, academic institutions, think tanks, and industry partners. Support the design of sustainable models for student skilling, faculty development, curriculum development, certifications, and employability initiatives. Stay informed about talent trends, workforce requirements, national skilling priorities, and CSR regulations. Program Monitoring & Impact Measurement Define and track program KPIs, beneficiary metrics, learning outcomes, and impact indicators. Drive collection and validation of data from implementing partners and educational institutions. Prepare leadership dashboards, quarterly reviews, CSR reports, and impact assessments. Present project status, risks, achievements, and recommendations to senior leadership and external stakeholders. Team Coordination Coordinate cross-functional teams including content partners, training providers, academic coordinators, and implementation agencies. Ensure alignment among internal and external stakeholders to meet project goals. Mentor junior project team members where applicable. Required Qualifications Bachelors degree in Engineering, Computer Science, Management, Public Policy, Education, or related field. Masters degree (MBA/PGDM/Public Policy/Project Management) preferred. Project Management certifications (PMP, PRINCE2, Agile, etc.) will be an added advantage. Experience Requirements 8-15 years of relevant experience. Must have: Proven experience managing large-scale CSR, education, skilling, workforce development, or social impact programs. Demonstrated track record of end-to-end project management and multi-stakeholder coordination. Experience working with government institutions, universities, implementation partners, and corporate CSR teams. Strong understanding of the CSR ecosystem, education ecosystem, and skilling landscape in India. Experience managing programs related to technology, cybersecurity, digital skills, AI, or emerging technologies will be highly preferred. Desired Profile The ideal candidate should: Possess deep understanding of the skilling ecosystem. Be well-connected across industry, academia, government, and nonprofit sectors. Have strong executive presence and stakeholder engagement capabilities. Demonstrate exceptional project planning, governance, and problem-solving skills. Be comfortable managing multiple projects simultaneously across regions. Have strong analytical, reporting, and presentation skills. Be highly organized, outcome-driven, and capable of working independently in complex environments. Key Competencies Program & Project Management CSR Program Management Stakeholder Management Government Relations Academic Partnerships Strategic Partnerships & Ecosystem Building Risk Management Impact Measurement & Reporting Leadership Communication Success Metrics On-time and on-budget project delivery. Achievement of program reach, participation, certification, and placement targets. High stakeholder satisfaction across government, academia, and partners. Strong governance and compliance adherence. Successful creation and expansion of ecosystem partnerships. Demonstrable social impact and measurable program outcomes. This role is ideal for a professional who combines strong project management expertise with a deep understanding of the CSR, education, and ecosystem and can effectively engage leaders across government, academia, and industry to deliver transformative social impact programs.

title: Inventory Manager
description:
Job Description: Inventory Manager Location: Gurugram Employment Type: Full-Time 
 About the Role We are looking for a proactive and detail-oriented Inventory Manager to oversee stock control, purchase coordination, and warehouse operations at our factory. The ideal candidate will have hands-on experience in procurement/purchase functions and strong leadership abilities to manage and mentor a team on the factory floor. 
 Key Responsibilities Inventory & Warehouse Management • Maintain optimal stock levels of raw materials, WIP, and finished goods to avoid production stoppages or overstocking • Conduct regular physical stock verification and reconcile with system records (ERP/inventory software) • Implement and monitor inventory control systems (FIFO/FEFO, ABC analysis, min-max levels, reorder points) • Ensure proper storage, labeling, and handling of materials as per safety and quality standards • Manage GRN (Goods Receipt Note), material issue slips, and stock transfer documentation Purchase & Procurement • Coordinate with the purchase team/vendors for timely procurement of raw materials and consumables • Raise purchase requisitions/indents based on production planning and stock analysis • Negotiate pricing, delivery timelines, and payment terms with vendors • Evaluate vendor performance and maintain vendor database • Track purchase orders and follow up on delivery schedules to avoid material shortages Leadership & Team Management • Lead, train, and supervise the inventory/store team, including store keepers and helpers • Allocate daily tasks, monitor performance, and ensure discipline on the factory floor • Coordinate with production, quality, and dispatch teams to ensure smooth material flow • Drive process improvements and enforce SOPs across the store/warehouse function • Handle escalations and resolve operational bottlenecks independently Reporting & Compliance • Prepare and present periodic stock reports, purchase reports, and variance analysis to management • Ensure compliance with statutory and internal audit requirements related to inventory • Support cost-control initiatives by identifying wastage, obsolete stock, and process inefficiencies

Digital transformation is not just about new technologies; it involves an overhaul of organizational structures, governance, work processes, culture and mindset. It also means realizing a wider vision of relationships and business models that will redesign how public services function. To achieve this vision, we help clients balance strategic choices to re-ignite performance. We have developed a suite of cross-service line strategic solutions that align with our client priorities. We have a proud record of helping governments meet their challenges head-on, and we work closely with them to build a world that works better for all citizens. CNS - Risk - Risk Management : EY Consulting is building a better working world by transforming businesses through the power of people, technology and innovation. Our client-centric approach focuses on driving long-term value for our clients by solving their most strategic problems. EY Consulting is made up of three sub-service lines: Business Consulting (including Performance Improvement and Risk Consulting), Technology Consulting and People Advisory Services. We help our clients in identifying and managing the interplay between upside and downside risk in order to make the long-term decisions to prevent risk and impact on their organization's ability to meet its future business strategy and objectives. The 3 key fields of play are : Enterprise Risk - helps clients identify and address key risk areas, while building the agility to respond quickly. The areas of focus include Enterprise risk and resilience, Internal audit, Compliance and Internal controls Technology Risk - helps clients to achieve sustainable growth by supporting their efforts to protect their business performance and by providing trusted communications on internal control and regulatory compliance to investors, management, regulators, customers and other stakeholders. EY teams accomplish this by assessing the technology risks that are introduced to businesses. Financial Services Risk - helps clients in the financial sector to identify, manage and monitor the risks in their business. It is done through a transformative and agile approach including process and procedures, risk, data modeling and analytics, reporting to stakeholders and third parties, business requirements (for software selection and IT implementation), analysis of assets and liabilities, and capital and liquidity management. Your key responsibilities Proven experience in business consulting and risk management practices within government or public sector environments. Strong ability to support risk assessments, control reviews, and issue analysis using structured consulting approaches. Hands-on experience in project management, including planning, tracking, and coordinating deliverables across workstreams. Ability to apply general consulting skills to gather requirements, analyze gaps, and document actionable recommendations. Familiarity with risk-focused engagement execution, stakeholder coordination, and delivery of consulting outputs in a government context. Skills and attributes To qualify for the role you must have Master of Commerce Post Graduate Diploma in Management Master of Business Administration Experience Project Management (6+ years) What we look for People with the ability to work in a collaborative manner to provide services across multiple client departments while following the commercial and legal requirements. You will need a practical approach to solving issues and complex problems with the ability to deliver insightful and practical solutions. We look for people who are agile, curious, mindful, and able to sustain positive energy, while being adaptable and creative in their approach.
